# TURNOUT
```{r}
turnout_files <- list.files("../data/turnout/", pattern = "\\.xlsx?$")

turnout <- map_dfr(turnout_files, ~ read_excel(paste0("../data/turnout/", .x), col_types = "text")) |>
  clean_names() |>
  select(year, election, party, county, eligible_voters, polls, early, provisional, absentee) |>
  mutate(year = as.character(year),
         eligible_voters = as.numeric(eligible_voters),
         polls = as.numeric(polls),
         pct_polls = polls / eligible_voters,
         early = as.numeric(early),
         pct_early = early / eligible_voters,
         provisional = as.numeric(provisional),
         pct_provisional = provisional / eligible_voters,
         absentee = as.numeric(absentee),
         pct_absentee = absentee / eligible_voters,
         turnout = (polls + early + provisional + absentee),
         pct_turnout = turnout / eligible_voters) |>
  select(year, election, party, county, eligible_voters, turnout, pct_turnout, polls, pct_polls, early, pct_early, provisional, pct_provisional, absentee, pct_absentee)
```

```{r}
general <- turnout |>
  filter(election == "GENERAL", county != "TOTAL") |>
  mutate(pct_turnout = as.numeric(pct_turnout)) |>
  arrange(county, year) |>
  group_by(county) |>
  mutate(prior_midterm_turnout = lag(pct_turnout)) |>
  ungroup()

primary_statewide_turnout <- turnout |>
  filter(election == "PRIMARY", party == "ALL", county != "TOTAL") 

write_csv(general |>
            select(year, election, party, county, eligible_voters, turnout, pct_turnout, early, pct_early, prior_midterm_turnout), "../data/processed/historical_midterm_turnout.csv")
```

# DEMOGRAPHICS
```{r}
age_65_up  <- sprintf("B01001_%03d", c(20:25, 44:49))

vars <- c(
  total_pop        = "B01003_001",
  median_age       = "B01002_001",
  white_nh         = "B03002_003",
  black_nh         = "B03002_004",
  asian_nh         = "B03002_006",
  hispanic         = "B03002_012",
  race_total       = "B03002_001",
  median_hh_income = "B19013_001",
  edu_total        = "B15002_001",
  bach_m = "B15002_015", 
  masters_m = "B15002_016", 
  prof_m = "B15002_017", 
  doc_m = "B15002_018",
  bach_f = "B15002_032", 
  masters_f = "B15002_033", 
  prof_f = "B15002_034", 
  doc_f = "B15002_035",
  civ_labor_force  = "B23025_003",
  unemployed       = "B23025_005",
  setNames(age_65_up,  paste0("age65up_", seq_along(age_65_up)))
)

years <- c(2011, 2014, 2018, 2022, 2024)

demographics <- map(years, \(y) {
  get_acs(
    geography = "county",
    state     = "MD",
    variables = vars,
    year      = y,
    survey    = "acs5"
  ) |>
    mutate(year = ifelse(y == 2011, 2010, ifelse(y == 2024, 2026, y)))
}) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  clean_names() |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(geoid, name, year),
    names_from  = variable,
    values_from = c(estimate, moe)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    pct_white = estimate_white_nh / estimate_race_total,
    pct_black = estimate_black_nh / estimate_race_total,
    pct_hispanic = estimate_hispanic / estimate_race_total,
    pct_bachelors_higher = rowSums(pick(estimate_bach_m:estimate_doc_f)) / estimate_edu_total,
    pct_unemployed = estimate_unemployed / estimate_civ_labor_force,
    pct_65_up  = rowSums(pick(starts_with("estimate_age65up_")))   / estimate_total_pop,
    county = ifelse(name == "Baltimore city, Maryland", "Baltimore City", 
             ifelse(name == "Baltimore County, Maryland", "Baltimore County", 
             ifelse(name == "St. Mary's County, Maryland", "Saint Mary's", 
             str_remove(name, " County, Maryland")))),
    year = as.character(year)
    ) |>
  select(county, year, population = estimate_total_pop, pct_white, pct_black, pct_hispanic,
         median_age = estimate_median_age, pct_65_up, pct_bachelors_higher,
         pct_unemployed, median_household_income = estimate_median_hh_income)


write_csv(demographics |>
            select(county, year, pct_black, median_household_income) |>
            filter(year %in% c(2010, 2014, 2018, 2022)), "../data/historical/historical_demographics.csv")

write_csv(demographics |>
            select(county, year, pct_black, median_household_income) |>
            filter(year == 2026), "../data/processed/2026/2026_demographics.csv")
```

# POLLING PLACES
## 2010

```{r}
polling_places_2010 <- read_csv("../data/polling_places/2010_polling_places.csv") |>
  separate(col = "County Precincts Polling_Places", into = c("county", "data"), sep = "ty ") |>
  separate(col = "data", into = c("precincts","polling_places"), sep = " ") |>
  mutate(county = ifelse(county == "Baltimore Ci", "Baltimore City", 
                  ifelse(county == "Baltimore Coun", "Baltimore County",
                  ifelse(county == "St. Mary's Coun", "Saint Mary's",
                  str_remove(county, " Coun"))))) |>
  mutate(year = "2010",
         precincts = as.numeric(precincts),
         polling_places = as.numeric(polling_places),
         polling_places_per_precinct = polling_places / precincts) |>
  select(year, county, precincts, polling_places, polling_places_per_precinct)
```

# ANALYSIS
## MODELING

```{r}
general <- turnout |>
  filter(election == "GENERAL", party == "ALL", county != "TOTAL") |>
  mutate(pct_turnout = as.numeric(pct_turnout)) |>
  arrange(county, year) |>
  group_by(county) |>
  mutate(prior_midterm_turnout = lag(pct_turnout)) |>
  ungroup()

model_data <- general |>
  left_join(demographics, join_by(year, county)) |>
  left_join(polling_places, join_by(year, county)) |>
  left_join(presidential_approval, join_by(year)) |>
  left_join(generic_ballot, join_by(year)) |>
  filter(!is.na(prior_midterm_turnout))
```


```{r}
candidates <- list(
  base = pct_turnout ~ prior_midterm_turnout,
  early = pct_turnout ~ pct_early,
  black = pct_turnout ~ pct_black,
  income = pct_turnout ~ median_household_income,
  early_black = pct_turnout ~ pct_early + pct_black,
  base_early_black = pct_turnout ~ prior_midterm_turnout + pct_early + pct_black,
  early_black_income = pct_turnout ~ pct_early + pct_black + median_household_income,
  base_early_black_income = pct_turnout ~ prior_midterm_turnout + pct_early + pct_black + median_household_income
)
  
  
backtest <- function(f, hold = "2014") {
  fit  <- glm(f, family = quasibinomial, weights = eligible_voters,
              data = filter(model_data, year != hold))
  test <- filter(model_data, year == hold)
  mean(abs(predict(fit, test, type = "response") - test$pct_turnout)) * 100
}

map_dbl(candidates, backtest) 

finalists <- candidates[c("base", "base_early", "base_black", "base_primary", "base_early_black", "base_early_primary", "base_black_primary", "base_early_black_primary")]

holdouts <- c("2014", "2018", "2022")
map_dbl(candidates, \(f) mean(map_dbl(holdouts, \(h) backtest(f, h)))) |> sort()
```

```{r}
f <- candidates$early_black_income

map(holdouts, \(h) {
  fit  <- glm(f, family = quasibinomial, weights = eligible_voters, # your weight column
              data = filter(model_data, year != h))
  filter(model_data, year == h) |>
    mutate(err = predict(fit, pick(everything()), type = "response") - pct_turnout) |>
    summarise(hold = h,
              total_error    = mean(abs(err)) * 100,
              statewide_bias = mean(err) * 100,
              county_error   = mean(abs(err - mean(err))) * 100)
}) |> list_rbind()
```

```{r}
fit <- glm(f, family = quasibinomial, weights = eligible_voters,
           data = filter(model_data, year != "2022"))

filter(model_data, year == "2022") |>
  mutate(predicted = predict(fit, pick(everything()), type = "response")) |>
  select(county, pct_turnout, predicted) |>
  mutate(miss = predicted - pct_turnout) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(miss)))
```

```{r}
side_by_side <- map(c("2014", "2018", "2022"), \(h) {
  fit <- glm(f, family = quasibinomial, weights = eligible_voters,
             data = filter(model_data, year != h))
  filter(model_data, year == h) |>
    mutate(predicted = predict(fit, pick(everything()), type = "response"))
}) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  select(year, county, pct_turnout, predicted) |>
  mutate(miss = predicted - pct_turnout)

ggplot(side_by_side, aes(pct_turnout, predicted, label = county)) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ year) +
  coord_equal()
```

# FINAL MODEL

```{r}
historical <- model_data |>
  select(year, county, eligible_voters, turnout, pct_turnout, pct_early, pct_black, median_household_income)

final_fit <- glm(
  cbind(turnout, eligible_voters - turnout) ~ pct_black + pct_early + median_household_income,
  family = quasibinomial, 
  data = historical
)
summary(final_fit)
```

## 2026
```{r}
eligible_voters_2026 <- read_csv("../data/2026/2026_eligible_voters.csv") |>
  separate(col = "DEM REP GRN OTH UNA WCP TOTAL", into = c("DEMOCRATIC", "REPUBLICAN", "GREEN", "OTHER", "UNAFFILIATED", "WORKING CLASS PARTY", "ALL"), sep = " ") |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(DEMOCRATIC, REPUBLICAN, GREEN, OTHER, UNAFFILIATED, "WORKING CLASS PARTY", ALL), names_to = "party", values_to = "eligible_voters")  |>
  mutate(year = "2026",
         election = "GENERAL",
         eligible_voters = str_remove_all(eligible_voters, ","),
         eligible_voters = as.numeric(eligible_voters)) |>
  select(year, election, party, county, eligible_voters)

early_voting_2026 <- read_csv("../data/2026/2026_early_voting.csv") |>
  separate(col = "DAY1 %Day1 DAY2 %Day2 DAY3 %Day3 DAY4 %Day4 DAY5 %Day5 DAY6 %Day6 DAY7 %Day7 DAY8 %Day8 TOTAL %Total Eligible_Actives", into = c("day1", "pct_day1", "day2", "pct_day2", "day3", "pct_day3", "day4", "pct_day4", "day5", "pct_day5", "day6", "pct_day6", "day7", "pct_day7", "day8", "pct_day8", "early", "pct_total", "eligible_voters"), sep = " ") |>
  mutate(year = "2026") |>
  select(year, county, early, eligible_voters) |>
  mutate(across(c(early, eligible_voters), str_remove_all, ","),
         across(c(early, eligible_voters), as.numeric),
         pct_early = early / eligible_voters)

write_csv(eligible_voters_2026, "../data/processed/2026_eligible_voters.csv")
write_csv(early_voting_2026, "../data/processed/2026_early_voting.csv")
```

```{r}
data_2026 <- eligible_voters_2026 |>
  filter(party == "ALL") |>
  left_join(early_voting_2026, join_by(year, county, eligible_voters)) |>
  left_join(demographics |> filter(year == "2026"), join_by(year, county)) |>
  select(year, county, eligible_voters, pct_early, pct_black, median_household_income)
```

```{r}
data_2026 <- data_2026 |>
  mutate(
    predicted_pct_turnout = predict(final_fit, newdata = data_2026, type = "response"),
    predicted_turnout   = predicted_pct_turnout * eligible_voters
  )

q <- quantile(side_by_side$pct_turnout - side_by_side$predicted, c(0.05, 0.95))

data_2026 <- data_2026 |>
  mutate(lo = predicted_pct_turnout + q[1], hi = predicted_pct_turnout + q[2])

data_2026 |> summarise(statewide = sum(predicted_turnout) / sum(eligible_voters))
```
